why: Restores the player-only gate this had as a refusal arm, where it was correct: an enemy's REFUSAL would have reported the enemy's ammunition state to the player. That reason does not survive #526 -- firing is already visible, the shell is right there -- and the gate now produces enemy guns that stay rigid while the player's kicks. A stale guard whose original justification has been removed is exactly the kind of thing a port forward reintroduces.
killedBy: barrel recoil (issue #526, parent #356) recoils EVERY living tank, enemies included, and never a dead one
